name: slam_a
description: Phase 0 A: the round-0 agent door slam, rebuilt as it was; output set to -28 LUFS for the listening test.

name: slam_b
description: Phase 0 B: layered synthetic door slam with a bus chain and room, tuned by search against two CC0 references (mean STFT distance 10.08 dB). -28 LUFS.

name: slam_b2
description: Phase 0 B2, after the listening notes: dry and mono, atonal noise weight (no sine), wood modal excited by noise, friction brush before the hit, wood-on-wood knock instead of the metal latch/rattle. Search-tuned; brush held at -10 dB. -28 LUFS.
prompt: B still sounds a bit too melodic like a tuned drum; the real door is atonal, weightier and snappier; SFX should be dry; real recording has a subtle frictional sound before the hit; the second hit sounds like a chime or rusted metal, not wood on wood.

name: slam_c
description: Phase 0 C: recorded slam (Freesound 571797, CC0) pitched down plus synthetic sub, latch, bus chain and room, tuned by search (9.49 dB). -28 LUFS.

name: slam_real
description: Phase 0 control: the unprocessed CC0 recording (Freesound 571797), -28 LUFS. Its distance to the two scoring refs is 10.40 dB.
